name: RoadLens - Critical Hazard Emergency Dispatch & Weather Quality Predictor

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "channel": "#emergency-services-civil-defense",
  "priority": "EMERGENCY_TIER_1",
  "hazard_type": "ROADWAY FLOOD / SEVERE INUNDATION",
  "confidence": "{{ ($json.confidence * 100).toFixed(1) }}%",
  "severity_level": "{{ $json.weather_adjusted_severity }} / 5.0 (LIFE_SAFETY_CRITICAL)",
  "weather_condition": "{{ $json.weather_condition }}",
  "predictive_road_quality_index": "{{ $json.predicted_rqi }} / 100",
  "hydroplaning_danger": "{{ $json.hydroplaning_risk_pct }}%",
  "coordinates": {
    "latitude": {{ $json.latitude }},
    "longitude": {{ $json.longitude }}
  },
  "google_maps_url": "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query={{ $json.latitude }},{{ $json.longitude }}",
  "action_plan": [
    "1. Immediate closure of road segment between nearest highway ramps",
    "2. Deploy mobile stormwater vacuum units",
    "3. Broadcast emergency lane hazard notification to transit navigation feeds"
  ],
  "device_id": "{{ $json.device_id }}",
  "timestamp": "{{ $json.timestamp }}"
}

={
  "channel": "#highway-patrol-rapid-response",
  "priority": "URGENT",
  "hazard_type": "ROAD DEBRIS / OBSTRUCTION",
  "confidence": "{{ ($json.confidence * 100).toFixed(1) }}%",
  "severity_level": "{{ $json.severity_score }} / 5.0",
  "weather_condition": "{{ $json.weather_condition }}",
  "predictive_road_quality": "{{ $json.predicted_rqi }} / 100",
  "coordinates": {
    "latitude": {{ $json.latitude }},
    "longitude": {{ $json.longitude }}
  },
  "google_maps_url": "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query={{ $json.latitude }},{{ $json.longitude }}",
  "next_step_instructions": [
    "1. Dispatch nearest Highway Patrol Interceptor unit",
    "2. Clear carriageway obstruction within 15-minute SLA",
    "3. Log clearance status"
  ],
  "device_id": "{{ $json.device_id }}",
  "timestamp": "{{ $json.timestamp }}"
}
